description: Create a static DNAT to the server IPMI (nat/add_static_nat): public IP for classic IPMI access. Distinct from Secure IPMI Proxy in the panel — Proxy Active alone may not satisfy this call. Async; track with check_task. On server_ipmi_acl_required pass ip_acl.

confirm.description: Must be true to run the operation.

ip_acl.description: Client IP(s) allowed to reach IPMI via NAT (InvAPI ip_acl). Required by some accounts when panel Proxy ACL is not enough.

secured.description: Secured NAT flag if supported by InvAPI

ttl.description: NAT lifetime in seconds, if supported

name: add_static_nat
